Curry Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
By: Munchin with Mu...
Published: Tuesday, October 18, 2011 - 10:55am

Ingredients




pumpkin seeds
cooking spray
1 Tbsp. curry powder
1 Tsp. salt

Preparation

1 Clean pumpkin seeds and spread on a cookie sheet overnight to dry. 2 Preheat oven to 350 3 Spray seeds with cooking spray and season with curry powder and salt. 4 Roast in the oven for 40 minutes, flipping after 20.

About

Roasted pumpkin seeds seasoned with West Indian curry powder. A spin on the classic October snack.
